thread:
maya: quick check-in ownership experiment rolled to cohort-C overnight. correctness good, but p95 edged up.
sanjay: numbers?
maya: sample window 01:00-03:00 UTC:
```
requests: 180k
p50: 30ms
p95: 380ms (baseline 320ms)
cache hit: 14% (baseline 33%)
gpu avg: 62%
```
maya: looks like cache locality loss + a few short GPU spikes when KV repop occurs.
owen: did batching change?
maya: no, only ownership routing + adapter. routing increased cross-pod lookups for long contexts.
lucy: low-risk mitigation candidates?
maya: thinking: soft affinity, targeted cache prewarm for top prefixes, and one-hour canary gate with heatmap check.
sanjay: agree. add automated abort if any tenant p95 >1.25x baseline during canary. and heatmap delta >10% per-pod.
owen: I'll prototype a soft-affinity shim feature-flagged; aim to land in 3h.
lucy: I'll update rollback checklist + ownership semantics doc.
infra-bot: canary monitor created: ownership.cohortC.p95 > baseline*1.25 (id oc-771)
maya: thanks team 1. we'll hold broad rollout until prewarm + affinity are validated.
